title: India-US trade agreement nearing completion, says commerce minister
paragraphs: India-US trade agreement nearing completion, says commerce minister
The US announced on Wednesday that Indian goods would face tariffs of 17 per cent if a trade deal is reached, but could rise to as much as 25 per cent if not.

NEW DELHI: India said on Friday (Nov 27) it was close to finalising a long-awaited trade deal with the United States after Washington proposed higher tariffs on the country’s goods if negotiations fail.
